empty.title: Install the missing models
empty.avatar: An avatar model: a video model with the avatarforcing-cpp backend, for example avatarforcing from the gallery.
empty.tts: A text-to-speech model, to give the reply a voice.
empty.licence: The avatarforcing weights are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0: use them for non-commercial purposes only.
empty.errorTitle: The models could not be listed

notices.notAvatar: {{model}} is not a talking-head model. Pick an avatar model in the settings.
notices.notStored: This browser did not keep the portrait. It stays until you close the page.
notices.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Kept in this browser. They apply to the next turn.
settings.pipelineHelp: A pipeline model sets the chat, transcription and speech models at once.
settings.voicePlaceholder: Voice name (blank for the model default)
settings.instructionsHelp: Sent to the chat model before the conversation. Ask for short replies: each second of speech is a second of video to make.
settings.nfeHelp: Sampler steps of the avatar model, 3 to 12. The default is 6. A lower value is faster and less detailed.
settings.cpuNote: Video is slow on a CPU: about 15 seconds of work for each second of speech. A GPU is much faster.
settings.licence: The avatarforcing weights are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0: use them for non-commercial purposes only.

crop.title: Crop the portrait
crop.desc: Put one face in the middle of the square.
crop.unreadable: This file is not an image the browser can read. Try a PNG or a JPEG.
crop.preview: Crop preview. Use the arrow keys to move the picture.
crop.help: Drag the picture or use the arrow keys. The face should fill about half of the square. The portrait stays in this browser.

status.readyBody: Hold the button and speak, or type a message.
status.recordingBody: Release the button to send what you said.
status.noPortraitBody: Upload a photo of one face. You crop it to a square here.
status.videoSlow: Making the clip. On a CPU this takes about 15 seconds for each second of speech.

blocked.title: Microphone blocked
blocked.body: Click the lock icon in the address bar, set Microphone to Allow, then try again. Nothing was recorded.

missing.title: No microphone
missing.body: This browser has no microphone it can use. Type your message instead.

error.title: The microphone did not start
error.body: Try again, or type your message instead.

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Type a message for the face to answer
composer.placeholderSay: Type what the face should say
composer.holdHelp: Hold the button while you speak, then release it.
composer.noStt: Install a transcription model to talk by voice.
composer.note: Reply asks the chat model and the face speaks its answer. Say this makes the face speak your text as it is.

transcript.title: Conversation
transcript.empty: Your messages and the replies appear here, each with its clip. They stay in this tab and are not saved.

errors.tooShort: The recording was too short. Hold the button while you speak.
errors.emptyTranscript: No words were heard in the recording. Try again closer to the microphone.
errors.emptyReply: The chat model gave an empty reply. Try again, or try another model.

face.portraitAlt: The portrait that speaks the replies
face.empty: Upload a portrait to see the face here.
face.unplayable: This browser cannot play the clip: it has no H.264 video decoder. Download the clip to watch it.
